Mortgage calculators

Twelve calculators covering the whole life of a mortgage. They start with what you could borrow, go through what it costs, and end with what happens when the fixed period ends.

Before you start: if you've got a personal loan, a credit card balance or car finance, a lender will offer you less because of it. The affordability calculator takes that into account, and this guide explains the arithmetic.

Quick Mortgage Payment Check

If you just want a quick sense of the monthly payment, start here. It's the fastest check on the site.
